title: Staging-to-Prod Handover and Surge Mitigation Worksheet (Feb 2026) - Draft
content:
Purpose:
This doc is the working worksheet for the next staging->prod handoff window (see proposed calendar below). It focuses on two things: 1) a compact preflight/cutover checklist tailored for services that share the GPU inference fleet, and 2) pragmatic surge mitigation and graceful-degradation options to reduce blast radius during early traffic growth.

Status: draft, intended for cross-team review (SRE, Serving Runtime, Platform, Product). Not yet signed off by Eng Leadership.

Release window (candidate):
- Primary window: 2026-02-22 00:00 - 04:00 PT (4h)
- Safety buffer: 2026-02-22 04:00 - 08:00 PT (monitoring, roll-forward)
- Backout window: immediate, up to 2026-02-23 02:00 PT if rollback needed

Stakeholders and escalation contacts:
- Release owner: Ava Chen (release lead) - paged via Slack/phone
- SRE on-call: Miguel Alvarez (primary), Priya Nair (secondary)
- Serving runtime tech lead: Liam Patel
- Product PM: Sofia Reyes
- Biz-critical contact: Jenna Morris (GTM) - only if customer-impacting

Preflight checklist (to be completed no later than 24h before window):
- [ ] Canary traffic has been running >= 12h with no regressed latency P99 or error-rate > 0.5%
- [ ] Perf baseline snapshot captured (tokens/sec, GPU utilization, median latency) and uploaded to /confluence/prod-deploy-guidelines
- [ ] Model variant compatibility matrix validated (quantized variant meets quality gates for top-10 prompts)
- [ ] Autoscaling policy smoke test: simulated throughput ramp to 1.5x expected peak, confirm >90% success on instance spin-up
- [ ] Rollback artifact prepared: pinned model version id + image tag + terraform rollback commit hash
- [ ] Feature flags documented and toggles prepared (FF keys + owners)
- [ ] Telemetry sampling set to 100% for trace-critical routes for first 30 minutes, then 10% afterward
- [ ] Alerts reviewed and suppressed list (if any) annotated to avoid noisy paging

Cutover sequence (high level):
1) Pre-window warmup (T-60m): ensure warm helper processes running, KV caches primed using synthetic prefixes.
2) Begin phased traffic shift (T-30m): route internal test traffic to prod variant (10%), verify health.
3) Controlled ramp (T+0 to T+45): increment by 10%-20% steps every 5 minutes while monitoring error rate and latency SLOs.
4) Stabilize and full shift (T+45 to T+90): if all green, increase to 100% live traffic.
5) Post-shift validation (T+90 to T+240): run smoke evals, check billing counters, and run A/B drift checks.

Surge mitigation options (ordered by severity - least to most):
- Transparent rate limit: apply soft throttling at edge for non-critical routes (sheds 10-30% of burst traffic).
- Reduced response fidelity: switch from full-context decoding to summary-mode for low-priority endpoints (reduces token cost and latency).
- Autoscale capacity burst: allow temporary cross-region borrow from Dedicated pool (requires approval from Platform).
- Progressive quantized fallback: if costly model variant starts to breach cost SLO, route new sessions to a lighter quantized model with fallback history caching.
- Emergency fallthrough: route to read-only cached responses / precomputed answers for top-20 queries for 30m window.

Rollback decision criteria (quick heuristics):
- Immediate rollback if: sustained error rate > 2% for 10m OR P99 latency regressed by >150% for 5m
- Consider partial rollback if: a single region shows abnormal queueing but others are fine (shift traffic away from affected region)
- Roll-forward when: bugfix or config tweak reduces error rate below 0.5% and P99 within baseline for 30m

Rollback procedure (if triggered):
- [ ] Pause new deployments and open rollback channel (#release-rollback)
- [ ] Trigger terraform/blue-green switch to previous image+model tag (document tag used)
- [ ] Invalidate KV cache keys that could cause stale state for old model (run cache-clear job in non-prod first)
- [ ] Re-run smoke evals and confirm traffic restored to baseline
- [ ] Post-mortem owner assigned within 24h

Telemetry and observability to watch (primary dashboards):
- Token-level billing: tokens/sec and cost per token (by model variant)
- Latency SLOs: median/95/99 latencies per endpoint and per region
- Queue depth and GPU utilization across pod types
- Error taxonomy: model-serving errors vs infra errors vs client errors
- End-to-end trace tail sampling for first 30 minutes

Release notes - draft (quick copy for product/comms):
- New: Deploys Model v3.1-alpha with improved long-context attention kernels (expected median latency improvement ~10% for long prompts).
- Performance: Automatic fallback to quantized-4bit variant for low-priority background requests to reduce overall per-token cost.
- Observability: Added token-level cost breakdown per route and an internal alert to notify if cost per request increases >25% over baseline.
- Known issues: Under rare conditions (<0.1%), session continuation across quantized fallback may drop last-turn context; mitigation in-progress.

Quick risk matrix (likelihood x impact):
- Regression in P99 latency: medium likelihood, high impact -> Mitigation: phased ramp + targetted throttles.
- Billing spike from unoptimized prompts: low likelihood, medium impact -> Mitigation: token-cost alert and temporary limit.
- Cross-region capacity contention: low likelihood, high impact -> Mitigation: cross-region borrowing and graceful degrade rules.

Open questions / notes to self:
- Confirm with Platform if cross-region borrowing needs a billing approval stamp or can be used by release lead.
- Is the 4h window excessive for small model-only changes? Consider moving to 2h with tighter preflight for minor ops.
- We need an on-call playbook snippet for "quantized fallback" that SREs can follow without runtime dev help.

Action items (owners):
- Ava: finalize deployment tags and publish to #release-prep (due 2026-02-18)
- Liam: smoke test autoscaler + provide perf snapshot (due 2026-02-18)
- Miguel: create temporary alert suppression list and provide SLO baseline (due 2026-02-20)
- Sofia: draft customer-facing release note and coordinate comms (due 2026-02-19)

Appendix - quick command snippets (internal runbook):
- Rollback command: kubectl set image deployment/model-serving model=image:v3.0.8 --namespace=prod
- Cache-clear job: kubectl create job clear-kv --image=tools/cache-clear --env=TARGET=all
- Telemetry toggles: /infra/ops toggle-telemetry --route all --sample 100 --duration 30m

References:
- Confluence: prod-deploy-guidelines (link above)
- GitHub PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/1824 (serving runtime changes)
- Jira: INF-2245 (quantized fallback epic)

If you are reviewing: please add comments inline or add items to the checklist above. This is intentionally compact so the on-call can scan quickly during the window.
